analysis.executiveSummary: All Hail King Jesus proposes sending Bryce Young, Zach Charbonnet, and Carson Wentz to Ravens Regime in exchange for Derrick Henry and Tony Pollard. From the perspective of All Hail King Jesus (goal: Increase Playoff Odds), this transaction would be a massive triumph, immediately erasing a glaring RB2 weakness (Kimani Vidal, 29.4 C-AVI) by slotting in Derrick Henry (80.0 C-AVI) and upgrading FLEX2 with Tony Pollard (66.8 C-AVI). However, from the perspective of Ravens Regime (explicit partner goal: Win Championship), trading away both starting RBs for a QB package and bench RB depth completely strips their championship lineup of high-volume rushing production, creating an irreparable starting RB hole. Consequently, Ravens Regime will reject this 3-for-2 proposal as constructed. AVI recommends revising the offer to target a single RB anchor (Tony Pollard) with a realistic multi-position package that preserves Ravens Regime's lineup integrity.

submitted.summary: Submitted trade heavily favors All Hail King Jesus (+60.9 net C-AVI gain), giving them two immediate high-end starting RBs (Derrick Henry and Tony Pollard) while giving up QB depth and an active-depth RB (Zach Charbonnet). title: Initial Trade Analysis · All Hail King Jesus ↔ Conquistadors

analysis.executiveSummary: The proposed 1-for-1 offer sending D'Andre Swift for Bijan Robinson strongly favors All Hail King Jesus in long-term dynasty stability and ceiling, but it lacks the premium value required to induce Conquistadors—a verified 'Win Championship' contender—to move a 24-year-old foundational superstar. While Swift's recent high-volume surge gives him strong current C-AVI (87.8), Bijan Robinson's generational profile, age advantage (24 vs. 27), and consensus top-tier market standing (95.8 D-AVI) demand additional assets. AVI recommends revising the offer by sweetening the package with premium depth or draft capital to create a realistic proposal.

submitted.summary: As constructed, All Hail King Jesus gains an elite 24-year-old cornerstone in Bijan Robinson while surrendering 27-year-old D'Andre Swift.
